    Philly G's Grow Empire

    EST. 215 · STAY LIFTED

    Skate your own shop and run it up into an empire.

    1. Drag anywhere to skate around.
    2. Skate into the Grow Room through the green door on the left, grab buds from the harvest bin and stock the Kush shelf. Other stations work the same way.
    3. Stand at the register to ring up customers, and grab the cash on the counter.
    4. Tap anywhere to pull a skate trick. Chain them for combos and street cred.
    5. Stand on a price pad to build stations, buy grow gear (lights, plant food, hydro) and store upgrades. Hire staff from the Hire tab at the bottom.

    18+ only. This is a work of fiction: a made-up shop in a made-up city. Nothing in the game is real, for sale, or shipped, and it doesn’t promote or help anyone buy or use cannabis. Every brand, product and character is invented, and any resemblance to real ones is a coincidence.
